features.quote: Run ends at S3, max turns, max tokens, or a single human abort signal.
Judge pipeline evaluates the transcript incrementally after each turn to detect early collapse.
Do not include tasks that instruct the model to self-harm
features.justification_quote: Instability should be induced via environmental contradiction, not adversarial persuasion toward misalignment.

features.quote: If testing pure task-recognition capability, cap history to the last 5 turns and measure ER in isolation.
features.justification_quote: the battery tests joint resilience to impossible tasks and long-context noise
